cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've circled Sunday like you. Another confirmed visit for Mum to get ready for. Don't leave me explaining an empty bed again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I circled my new work shift. I can't visit on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, Sunday noted. Last time it was overtime. You call Mum and tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to come. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You cancel, I soften; here we go again. You can arrange the replacement visit with her too.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
